image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vintage black hot rod car. The primary focus is on the front left wheel and tire, which features a polished chrome rim with deep-dish spokes and a thick black rubber tire. A secondary wheel (rear left) is visible in the background through the open wheel well, showing a similar style but with red brake calipers visible behind it. The car body is glossy black with a prominent fender arching over the front wheel. The ground is a textured concrete or paved surface.
